features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Intelligence-based prepared casting from a spellbook (starts with six 1st-level spells, +2 free spells per level). Prepare Int mod + wizard level spells after a long rest; ritual-cast spellbook rituals unprepared; arcane focus allowed.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.summary: Once per day after a short rest, recover expended slots whose combined level is at most half your wizard level rounded up; none may be 6th level or higher.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.summary: Choose one of eight schools (Abjuration, Conjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, Transmutation); it grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level raise one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.summary: Pick one 1st-level and one 2nd-level spellbook spell; while prepared, cast them at their base level without a slot. Swap choices with 8 hours of study.

features.name: Signature Spell
features.summary: (Section heading prints 'Signature Spells'.) Two chosen 3rd-level spellbook spells are always prepared, don't count against prepared spells, and each can be cast once at 3rd level without a slot per short or long rest.

resource.label: Signature spell free casts (one per spell)

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.summary: Copying abjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.summary: Casting a 1st+ level abjuration spell can create a ward on you (once per long rest) with HP 2 x wizard level + Int mod that absorbs damage to you; later abjuration spells restore 2 x spell level HP to it.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.summary: Reaction: when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, your Arcane Ward absorbs it instead; overflow goes to that creature.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.summary: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of casting abjuration spells (e.g. counterspell, dispel magic).

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.summary: Copying conjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.summary: Action: create a nonmagical-looking, faintly glowing object (max 3 ft per side, 10 lb) within 10 feet for 1 hour; ends early if damaged or reused.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.summary: Action: teleport up to 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Small/Medium creature. Recharges on a long rest or when you cast a 1st+ level conjuration spell.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.summary: Taking damage can't break your concentration on a conjuration spell.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.summary: Creatures you summon or create with conjuration spells gain 30 temporary hit points.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.summary: Copying divination spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Portent
features.summary: After each long rest roll two d20s and keep them; once per turn replace an attack roll, save, or ability check by you or a visible creature with one, decided before rolling. Unused rolls are lost on the next long rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.summary: Casting a divination spell of 2nd level or higher with a slot regains one expended slot of a lower level (5th level max).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.summary: Action: gain one chosen sense benefit until incapacitated or you take a short or long rest; reusable after a rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.summary: Portent gives you three d20s per long rest instead of two.

choices.name: Ethereal Sight
choices.summary: See into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet.

choices.name: See Invisibility
choices.summary: See invisible creatures and objects within 10 feet in line of sight.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.summary: Copying enchantment spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.summary: Action: a creature within 5 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until your next turn ends; sustain with an action each turn. On a save or end, can't target it again until a long rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.summary: Reaction: an attacker within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or must redirect its attack to the nearest other creature in range; on a success you can't use this on it until a long rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.summary: A 1st+ level enchantment spell that targets only one creature can target a second creature.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.summary: When you charm creatures with an enchantment spell, one stays unaware it was charmed; before the spell ends, an action can make it lose up to 1 + Cha mod hours of memory on a failed Int save.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.summary: Copying evocation spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.summary: When casting an evocation spell, choose up to 1 + spell level visible creatures; they automatically succeed on its saves and take no damage where a save would halve it.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.summary: Creatures that succeed on a save against your cantrip still take half its damage, without other effects.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.summary: Add your Intelligence modifier to the damage roll of wizard evocation spells you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.summary: Deal maximum damage with a damaging wizard spell of 5th level or lower. Free once per long rest; each further use before resting deals you 2d12 necrotic per spell level, +1d12 per level each time, ignoring resistance and immunity.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.summary: Copying illusion spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.summary: Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if known) without it counting against cantrips known; your minor illusion can make both a sound and an image.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.summary: Action: reshape an active illusion spell of yours with duration 1 minute or longer, within that spell's parameters, while you can see it.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.summary: Reaction to an attack roll against you: an illusory double makes the attack miss automatically.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.summary: While a 1st+ level illusion spell lasts, bonus action: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute; it can't deal damage or directly harm anyone.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.summary: Copying necromancy spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.summary: Once per turn, killing creatures with a 1st+ level spell heals you 2 x spell level (3 x for necromancy spells); not for constructs or undead.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.summary: Gain animate dead in your spellbook; it raises one extra corpse. Undead you create with necromancy get extra max HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.summary: Resistance to necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

features.name: Command Undead
features.summary: Action: an undead within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or becomes friendly and obeys you until you use this again; smart undead (Int 8+) get advantage, Int 12+ can re-save each turn. A success makes it permanently immune to this feature.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.summary: Copying transmutation spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.summary: Spend 10 minutes per cubic foot (up to 1 cubic foot) to turn wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper, or silver into another of those for 1 hour or until your concentration breaks.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.summary: Spend 8 hours to craft a stone granting its bearer one chosen benefit; casting a 1st+ level transmutation spell lets you change the benefit. Making a new stone ends the old one.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.summary: Add polymorph to your spellbook; once per short or long rest cast it without a slot on yourself only, becoming a beast of CR 1 or lower.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.summary: Action: destroy your transmuter's stone to produce one major effect; the stone can't be remade until a long rest.

choices.name: Energy resistance
choices.summary: Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (chosen each time this benefit is picked).

choices.name: Major Transformation
choices.summary: Over 10 minutes, turn a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into another nonmagical object of similar size and mass and equal or lower value.

choices.name: Panacea
choices.summary: Touched creature is cured of all curses, diseases, and poisons and regains all hit points.

choices.name: Restore Life
choices.summary: Cast raise dead by touch with no slot and no need to have it in your spellbook.

choices.name: Restore Youth
choices.summary: A willing touched creature's apparent age drops by 3d10 years (minimum 13); lifespan is not extended.

discrepancies: Seven of the eight PHB Arcane Traditions have no features in the app: abjuration, conjuration, divination, enchantment, illusion, necromancy, and transmutation each have an empty features array (only evocation is filled). That is 35 missing subclass features, e.g. Arcane Ward, Portent, Benign Transposition, Hypnotic Gaze, Grim Harvest, Minor Alchemy.

Class feature name: app uses 'Spellcasting: Wizard' (in progression and features); the PHB table and heading print 'Spellcasting'. The app's Spellcasting desc is a one-sentence stub (no spellbook of six spells, preparation formula Int mod + level, ritual casting, or 2 free spells per level).

Option lists missing: The Third Eye (Darkvision, Ethereal Sight, Greater Comprehension, See Invisibility), Transmuter's Stone benefits (darkvision, +10 ft speed, Con save proficiency, energy resistance), and Master Transmuter effects (Major Transformation, Panacea, Restore Life, Restore Youth) are not in the app (their subclasses are empty).

Limited-use resources not modelled: Arcane Recovery (1/day on a short rest; app only stores slot-level budget in progression.special.arcane_recovery_levels, which correctly equals ceil(level/2)), Signature Spell (each of two spells free once per short rest), Overchannel (free once per long rest), Portent dice (2, 3 from 14th), Arcane Ward HP (2 x level + Int), Benign Transposition, The Third Eye, Illusory Self, Shapechanger, Master Transmuter.

Evocation text differs from the printed PHB: app's Empowered Evocation says 'one damage roll' and Overchannel says '1st through 5th level' - these are later errata/SRD wording; the 2014 PHB print says 'the damage roll' and '5th level or lower'. Mention only if the app should match the original print.
Signature Spell: the class table prints 'Signature Spell' but the feature heading prints 'Signature Spells'; app uses the table form (acceptable).
Arcane Tradition feature desc names only Evocation ('such as Evocation'); the PHB lists all eight schools.

Matches the PHB: hit die d6, saves Int/Wis, no armor, weapons (daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, light crossbows), no tools, 2 skills from Arcana/History/Insight/Investigation/Medicine/Religion, Int casting, tradition at 2nd level with features at 6/10/14, cantrips known and all spell slot columns at all 20 levels, ASI levels, Spell Mastery 18, Signature Spell 20.
